# zenfra_space_grant (Resource)

Gives a team `read` or `write` on a space and every space below it. A grant on the root space applies to the whole organization. Grants add up (the highest one wins) and there are no deny rules. A `write` grant covers stacks, runs, bundles and spaces in the subtree, never organization administration (users, teams, API keys of others, integrations, policies, webhooks, state rollback, force-unlock). One grant per space and team. Requires an Admin token. Available after the organization's access-boundary activation; until then the API refuses the write with `access_boundaries_inactive`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Write on the networking space and every space below it.
resource "zenfra_space_grant" "platform_networking" {
  space_id = zenfra_space.networking.id
  team_id  = zenfra_team.platform.id
  role     = "write"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) `read` or `write`. Changes in place.
- `space_id` (String) The space. Changing it replaces the grant.
- `team_id` (String) The team. Changing it replaces the grant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format space_id/team_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zenfra_space_grant.platform_networking $SPACE_ID/$TEAM_ID
```
